• linc-2 is predicted to be involved in development; reproduction; metabolism; cellular localization and organization; immune response; rhythmic process; and response to stimuli.

Pathways:  
• linc-2 is predicted to be part of development; apoptosis; cell division; neuronal development and neurodegeneration; metabolism; and oxidative stress response.
